title: Run 27 execution package v2 specification approval v3
$comment: Package-scoped successor to schemas/spec_approval.schema.v2.json. v2 const-locks approved_graph to implementation.graph.v5.yaml -- the graph that reached BLOCKED at N20_PROVIDER_TRANSPORT with finding N20V2-F01 (retired_provider_test_scan.scan_roots swept the whole tests/runtime directory, including two unrelated Gemini-pipeline test files no node in this graph owns). implementation.graph.v6.yaml corrects exactly that write-set/scan-scope defect and is now this package's active graph, so approved_graph must const-lock to v6's path instead -- v5 remains a legitimate historical approved_graph value for the rc3/rc5 lineage it governed, preserved unedited at deprecated/implementation.graph.v5.yaml, but it is no longer *this* package's active graph. Every other field is unchanged in shape and meaning from schema v2; this is the same narrow, single-field correction discipline v2 itself used when it moved approved_spec off the parent v1 package's schema.

approved_spec.$comment: Unchanged from schema v2: this package's own single governing specification did not change in this correction.

spec_qa_verification_sha256.$comment: SHA-256 of plans/26_langgraph_curriculum_factory/spec/v3/QA/verification.json, the specification's own independent QA verification record. Unchanged from schema v2.

approved_rc_manifest.$comment: Unchanged from schema v2: still a versioned review-lineage pointer, not this package's governing identity. This correction does not re-anchor the package's approval-of-record to a new release candidate -- rc3 remains the approved package-structure snapshot; this graph-level scan-scope correction is validated by its own rc6 lineage (release_candidate/rc6/, and any rcN+ built to reach QA_PASSED), which is supporting engineering QA, not a fresh package approval. The validator recomputes approved_rc_manifest_sha256 against the file this path names and rejects a mismatch.

execution_package_qa_verification_sha256.$comment: SHA-256 of the approved RC's own QA/verification.json. Unchanged from schema v2.

approved_graph.$comment: Const-locked to this package's own active graph, exactly as v2 const-locks to v5. A future graph v7+ requiring fresh approval gets its own schema version, the same discipline this schema itself exists to apply. implementation.graph.v5.yaml remains a legitimate, unedited historical approved_graph value at deprecated/implementation.graph.v5.yaml, governed by schema v2, which is itself unedited and still valid for records that cite it.

model_assignments.$comment: Unchanged from schema v2: USER_DECISION_REQUIRED-01 is not reopened by this correction.
